settings.title: Notifications
settings.intro: GuGu Studio never emails your customers. They only get messages from the salon's Zalo OA.
settings.zaloConnected: Zalo OA connected. Customers who have chatted with the OA get confirmations, time changes, cancellations and reminders.
settings.zaloNotConnected: Zalo OA is not connected, so customers don't get automatic messages.
settings.zaloHint: Turn reminders on or off in the Zalo section.
settings.readOnly: Only the owner or a manager can change this.
